arxiv-2204-09635.creator: Alan Tang, Ryan Beckett, Steven Benaloh, Karthick Jayaraman, Tejas Patil, Todd Millstein, George Varghese
arxiv-2204-09635.description: Abstract . Current network control plane verification tools cannot scale to large networks because of the complexity of jointly reasoning about the behaviors of all network nodes. We present a modular approach to control plane verification, where end-to-end network properties are verified via a set of purely local checks on individual nodes and edges.

arxiv-2301-09730.title: Multiplicative Invariance for a Class of Subsets of the Complex Plane
arxiv-2301-09730.creator: Neil MacVicar
arxiv-2301-09730.description: Abstract . Multiplicative invariance is a well-studied property of subsets of the unit interval. The theory in the complex plane is less developed. This paper introduces an analogous definition for multiplicative invariance in the complex plane coinciding with a more general definition concerning subsets of attractors of iterated function systems satisfying the strong separation condition.

arxiv-2503-15483.title: Emergent coding phases and hardware-tailored quantum codes
arxiv-2503-15483.creator: Gaurav Gyawali, Henry Shackleton, Zhu-Xi Luo, Michael J. Lawler
arxiv-2503-15483.description: Abstract Finding good quantum codes for a particular hardware application and determining their error thresholds is central to quantum error correction. The threshold defines the noise level where a quantum code switches between a coding and a no-coding phase .

arxiv-2506-07863.title: VIVAT: Virtuous Improving VAE Training through Artifact Mitigation
arxiv-2506-07863.creator: Lev Novitskiy, Viacheslav Vasilev, Maria Kovaleva, Vladimir Arkhipkin, Denis Dimitrov
arxiv-2506-07863.description: Abstract Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) remain a cornerstone of generative computer vision, yet their training is often plagued by artifacts that degrade reconstruction and generation quality. This paper introduces VIVAT, a systematic approach to mitigating common artifacts in KL-VAE training without requiring radical architectural changes.

uslaw-usc-t16-s426a.title: 16 U.S.C. § 426a — Qualifications of members of commission
uslaw-usc-t16-s426a.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s426a.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 1 (National Parks, Military Parks, Monuments, And Seashores); Subchapter LX (National Military Parks). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In appointing the members of the commission created by section 426 of this title the Secretary of the Interior shall, as far as practicable, select persons familiar with the terrain of the battlefield of Stones River, Tennessee.
